summary: The root نخل (nkhl) means to clear, sift, or take the best part of something. It implies a process of selection, choosing the finest or most excellent portion.
lane: 8 اِنْنَخَلَهُ ذ He cleared it [or sifted it ]; as also and : (K [see سَفْسَفَهُ ]:) or he took the best of it (S, Msb) to the utmost: (S:) or he chose the best of it for himself. (TA.)
